name: KromiumExtensions
summary: Extension functions for streamlined creation of headless browser instances on KromiumEngine and KromiumClient.

methods.name: createHeadlessBrowser
methods.signature: fun KromiumEngine.createHeadlessBrowser(url: String = "about:blank", width: Int = 1280, height: Int = 800): KromiumBrowser
methods.description: Creates a new zero-dependency headless KromiumBrowser instance within a new isolated client session.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The initial width of the headless viewport.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The initial height of the headless viewport.

methods.signature: fun KromiumClient.createHeadlessBrowser(url: String = "about:blank", width: Int = 1280, height: Int = 800): KromiumBrowser
methods.description: Creates a new zero-dependency headless KromiumBrowser instance on this client.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The initial width of the headless viewport.

parameters.description: The initial height of the headless viewport.
